mapper.sql: id, standard_name, gender, age_min, age_max, activity_level, target_goal, daily_calories, protein_grams, fat_grams, carbs_grams, water_ml, status, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nutrition_standard WHERE status = 10 AND deleted = 0 AND (gender = 0 OR gender = #{gender}) AND (age_min IS NULL OR #{age} >= age_min) AND (age_max IS NULL OR #{age} <= age_max) AND (activity_level IS NULL OR activity_level = #{activityLevel}) AND target_goal = #{targetGoal} ORDER BY gender DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM nutrition_standard WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nutrition_standard (id, standard_name, gender, age_min, age_max, activity_level, target_goal, daily_calories, protein_grams, fat_grams, carbs_grams, water_ml, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{standardName}, #{gender}, #{ageMin}, #{ageMax}, #{activityLevel}, #{targetGoal}, #{dailyCalories}, #{proteinGrams}, #{fatGrams}, #{carbsGrams}, #{waterMl}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update:
UPDATE nutrition_standard
standard_name = #{standardName}, gender = #{gender}, age_min = #{ageMin}, age_max = #{ageMax}, activity_level = #{activityLevel}, target_goal = #{targetGoal}, daily_calories = #{dailyCalories}, protein_grams = #{proteinGrams}, fat_grams = #{fatGrams}, carbs_grams = #{carbsGrams}, water_ml = #{waterMl}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE nutrition_standard SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
